manifest_metadata.strategic_direction: Option C — Auditable Regulatory Decision Infrastructure
manifest_metadata.auditor: Principal Systems Architect & Independent Evaluation Lead

deliverables.description: Complete PRD requirements inventory (all 139 requirements extracted with exact text)
Detailed repository component architecture, data models, routes, and dead-code analysis
Full 139-requirement traceability matrix mapping backend, frontend, DB, contracts, and tests
Functional requirements verification report (FR-001 through FR-058 across Groups 1-7)
Non-functional and data architecture compliance report (NFR-001 to NFR-012, DATA-001 to DATA-015)
Security, cryptographic verification, trust boundaries, and commit-reveal integrity report (SEC-001 to SEC-018)
AI agent architecture, specialist roles, Pydantic schemas, Brier scoring, and calibration report (AGENT-001 to AGENT-015)
Smart contract architecture, Sepolia deployments, event logs, and EVM gas optimization report (SC-001 to SC-010)
Next.js 14 frontend, 6-area Decision Workspace, build results, and Vitest reports (UI-001 to UI-010)
Historical phase reconciliation, Option C evolution, and past claim debunking report (Phases 1-5F)
Machine-readable compliance metrics, status counts, benchmark numbers, and DB row counts
Complete gap register, root causes, severity ratings, remediation designs, and acceptance criteria for all partials
PRD acceptance test matrix and Definition of Done verification report (DOD-001 to DOD-011)
Final PRD compliance verdict, executive summary, answers to the 10 PRD questions, and sign-off
